title: Project scaffolding and build setup
description: Create pyproject.toml with all dependencies, src/video_capture_mcp/ package structure, __init__.py, and verify the project builds with uv. Include .gitignore for Python.
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml exists with correct dependencies and entry point
uv sync installs all dependencies without errors
uv run video-capture-mcp --help or entry point is callable
.gitignore covers Python artifacts, __pycache__, .venv

title: Shared utilities module
description: Create utils.py with make_image_result() helper that builds CallToolResult with ImageContent (base64 PNG), temp directory management (/tmp/video-capture-mcp/), and base64 encoding helpers.
acceptance_criteria: make_image_result() returns valid CallToolResult with ImageContent
Temp directory is created on demand and cleaned up
Unit tests pass for base64 encoding and result building

title: Camera device listing
description: Implement camera.py with list_cameras() that probes indices 0-9 via cv2.VideoCapture, returning available devices with index and resolution. Wire up as list_devices MCP tool in server.py with FastMCP.
acceptance_criteria: list_devices tool returns JSON array of available cameras
Each device entry has index, resolution, and availability
Probed cameras are released immediately after check
Server starts and responds to tools/list via stdio

title: Photo capture tool
description: Implement capture_frame() in camera.py with warm-up frame discard (5 frames for auto-exposure). Wire up as capture_photo MCP tool with device_index, width, height params. Returns base64 PNG via ImageContent.
acceptance_criteria: capture_photo returns a valid PNG image as base64 ImageContent
Warm-up frames are discarded before capturing final frame
Optional width/height resizing works
Error handling for missing/busy camera returns clear message
Integration test captures from device 0 if available

title: Video capture tool
description: Implement record_video() in camera.py with cv2.VideoWriter (mp4v codec). Wire up as capture_video MCP tool with duration_seconds (max 30), fps, and return_frames mode that extracts up to 5 evenly-spaced keyframes as ImageContent blocks.
acceptance_criteria: File mode saves MP4 to /tmp/video-capture-mcp/ and returns path
Frames mode returns up to 5 ImageContent blocks
Duration is capped at 30 seconds
Frame extraction selects evenly-spaced frames across the recording
Integration test records a short clip if camera available

title: OCR tool with preprocessing
description: Create ocr.py with preprocessing pipeline (auto/threshold/blur/none) for LCD/OLED screen reading. Wire up as ocr_image MCP tool that accepts file path or 'capture' for live frame. Returns extracted text + preprocessed image.
acceptance_criteria: OCR extracts text from a synthetic test image (Pillow-rendered text)
All 4 preprocessing modes produce output
Live capture mode works with image_source='capture'
Returns both extracted text and preprocessed image
Graceful error if tesseract not installed
Unit tests pass with synthetic images (no camera needed)

title: Image comparison tool
description: Implement compare_images() in imaging.py using skimage SSIM. Wire up as compare_images MCP tool. Returns SSIM score, change percentage, bounding boxes of changed regions, and optional diff visualization with red highlights.
acceptance_criteria: SSIM score computed correctly for identical images (1.0) and different images (<1.0)
Changed regions identified with bounding boxes via contour detection
Diff visualization highlights changes in red
Handles images of different sizes by resizing to match
Unit tests pass with synthetic image pairs (no camera needed)

title: Image manipulation tool
description: Implement manipulate_image() in imaging.py using Pillow. Supports crop, resize, rotate, annotate, brightness, and contrast operations applied sequentially from an operations list.
acceptance_criteria: Each operation type works correctly (crop, resize, rotate, annotate, brightness, contrast)
Operations chain sequentially
Returns processed image as ImageContent + summary text
Unit tests for each operation type with synthetic images

title: End-to-end tests and error handling
description: Add comprehensive error handling across all tools (camera not found, camera busy, tesseract missing, file not found, invalid params). Add integration tests that exercise the MCP protocol via stdio. Ensure all error paths return CallToolResult with isError=True.
acceptance_criteria: All error cases return isError=True with descriptive messages
MCP protocol test sends JSON-RPC via stdio and gets valid responses
Camera tests skip gracefully when no camera attached
OCR tests skip gracefully when tesseract not installed
pytest runs clean with no warnings

title: Documentation and Claude Code configuration
description: Update README.md with installation instructions (brew install tesseract, uv sync), usage examples for each tool, and Claude Desktop/Code configuration. Create .mcp.json for Claude Code integration.
acceptance_criteria: README has install steps, tool descriptions, and config examples
.mcp.json is valid and points to the correct entry point
Claude Desktop config example included
